e.body: Agrisky AI（穹野智保，XvHaoR/Agrisky-AI-Open，Apache-2.0，2026-08-15 建仓 / 2026-09-03 更新）是**开源的农业保险查勘、定损与理赔协同 Agent 工作台**，也是目前看到的「保险 Agent 治理」做得最完整的中文样本之一。核心设计：① **合规知识与合同闭环**——内置农业保险法规、保险法、农业法及条款费率文本并规范化为可引用语料，保单版本绑定并冻结保险合同 SHA-256 摘要，合同责任/保险期间/作物/生育期系数/赔付规则共同约束案件；② **可执行 Agent**——模型通过 **20 项白名单工具**读取案件、检索法规与合同、核验材料、调度遥感分析、测算赔付、生成带来源引用的报告草稿；③ **确定性定损**——面积、受灾比例、减产率、赔付金额与风险等级由服务端空间引擎、遥感分析与**版本化规则引擎**计算，模型只负责理解意图与编排工具，**不得直接改写关键数值**；④ **多源遥感证据链**——Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 NDVI 与植被指标，支持卫星初筛、当前长势、历史季度趋势与分地块分析，证据与计算过程写入案件审计链路；⑤ **人工审核门禁**——Agent 最多推进到 `REPORT_DRAFTED`，需具名管理员审核后才能进入 `ARCHIVED`；⑥ **可追溯交付**——报告/评估表/审计回执保留合同、法规、规则版本、技术指标与产物 SHA-256。工程上含 Docker/Caddy 编排、前后端分离、pytest 配置与演示视频。对 RIAA：这是「**模型提建议、人类做决定、全程可审计**」这一治理范式在保险场景的完整落地，与本 wiki 关注的 AI 治理主线直接呼应；农险是中国保费体量大且高度依赖查勘定损的险种，agent 化的价值点（遥感 + 规则 + 审计）非常典型；可对照 [[ins-mmbench]]（保险多模态基准）、[[evidence-review-claims]]（图像证据理赔裁决）、[[claims-triage-mcp]]（理赔分诊 MCP）、[[suture-vlm]]（核保 VLM）来看不同环节的 agent 化；遥感证据侧与 [[ml-drought]]、[[gdacs]] 等公开风险数据源属同一技术栈。注意：星标为 0（新项目），价值判断基于其工程完整度与治理设计。
e.body_en: Agrisky AI (XvHaoR/Agrisky-AI-Open, Apache-2.0, created 2026-08-15 / updated 2026-09-03) is an **open-source agent workbench for agricultural insurance survey, loss assessment and claims collaboration**, and one of the most complete Chinese-language samples of insurance agent governance found so far. Its design: (1) **compliance-knowledge and contract closure** — agricultural insurance regulations, insurance law, agricultural law and clause/rate texts are normalised into a citable corpus; the policy version is bound to a frozen SHA-256 digest of the contract, and liability, cover period, crop, growth-stage coefficients and payout rules jointly constrain the case; (2) **an executable agent** — the model uses **20 whitelisted tools** to read cases, retrieve regulations and contracts, verify materials, dispatch remote-sensing analysis, compute payouts and draft reports with source citations; (3) **deterministic loss assessment** — area, affected ratio, yield-reduction rate, payout and risk grade are computed by a server-side spatial engine, remote-sensing analysis and a **versioned rules engine**; the model only interprets intent and orchestrates tools and **may not rewrite key numbers**; (4) **a multi-source remote-sensing evidence chain** — Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 NDVI and vegetation indices support satellite screening, current growth, historical seasonal trends and per-plot analysis, with evidence and computation written into the case audit trail; (5) **a human review gate** — the agent can advance a case only to `REPORT_DRAFTED`; a named administrator must approve before `ARCHIVED`; (6) **traceable delivery** — reports, assessment tables and audit receipts retain contract, regulation, rule version, technical indicators and artefact SHA-256 hashes. Engineering includes Docker/Caddy orchestration, a separated front end and back end, pytest configuration and a demo video. For RIAA: a full implementation of "**the model advises, humans decide, and everything is auditable**" in an insurance setting, directly echoing this wiki’s AI-governance thread; agricultural insurance is a large Chinese line whose economics depend heavily on survey and loss assessment, so the agentic value points (remote sensing + rules + audit) are archetypal; compare with [[ins-mmbench]] (insurance multimodal benchmark), [[evidence-review-claims]] (image-evidence claims adjudication), [[claims-triage-mcp]] (claims triage MCP) and [[suture-vlm]] (underwriting VLM) to see agentification at different stages; on the remote-sensing side it shares a stack with public risk sources such as [[ml-drought]] and [[gdacs]]. Note: 0 stars (new project) — the judgement rests on engineering completeness and governance design.
e.body_hk: Agrisky AI（穹野智保，XvHaoR/Agrisky-AI-Open，Apache-2.0，2026-08-15 建倉 / 2026-09-03 更新）是**開源的農業保險查勘、定損與理賠協同 Agent 工作台**，也是目前所見「保險 Agent 治理」做得最完整的中文樣本之一。核心設計：① **合規知識與合同閉環**——內置農業保險法規、保險法、農業法及條款費率文本並規範化為可引用語料，保單版本綁定並凍結合約 SHA-256 摘要；② **可執行 Agent**——模型透過 **20 項白名單工具**讀取案件、檢索法規與合同、核驗材料、調度遙感分析、測算賠付、生成帶來源引用的報告草稿；③ **確定性定損**——面積、受災比例、減產率、賠付金額與風險等級由服務端空間引擎、遙感分析與**版本化規則引擎**計算，模型只負責理解意圖與編排工具，**不得直接改寫關鍵數值**；④ **多源遙感證據鏈**——Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 NDVI 與植被指標；⑤ **人工審核門禁**——Agent 最多推進到 `REPORT_DRAFTED`，需具名管理員審核後才能進入 `ARCHIVED`；⑥ **可追溯交付**——保留合約、法規、規則版本與產物 SHA-256。對 RIAA：這是「**模型提建議、人類做決定、全程可審計**」這一治理範式在保險場景的完整落地；可對照 [[ins-mmbench]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[suture-vlm]] 來看不同環節的 agent 化；遙感證據側與 [[ml-drought]]、[[gdacs]] 屬同一技術棧。注意：星標為 0（新項目）。
